description: Design reference from the Signal Flow prototype (Claude Design export, inline styles). The React version is not built yet, so rebuild this structure with the listed Carbon components and --at-* tokens; do not copy the prototype markup, which fails validate_page. Four-column board (To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done) with a detail panel, a theme filter (Tag chips), a priority filter and search. Cards are ClickableTiles showing priority, title, theme and a ProgressBar of criteria met. Drag between columns is a custom BoardColumn using HTML5 drag events; the prototype has no keyboard alternative, so the detail panel MUST include a 'Move to' Select that calls POST /stories/:id/move. Undo reverses the last move by the same person. The snippet is the hand-built reference card that passes validate_page.
